title: Supreme Leader Kylo Ren
description: After he eliminated his Master Supreme Leader Snoke, Kylo Ren was able to consolidate his hold over the First Order. Though he ruled the galaxy with his tyrannical gloved fist, he remained haunted by the loss of his father, his mysterious connection to Rey, and the constant pull to the light inside himself. Eventually, Ben Solo, the person he was, would make a return.
